tools_headline: OpenJev almost always picks the right tool. Laya is no better than keyword search.
tools_reading: OpenJev put the right tool first in 98.5% of requests and in the top 3 in all 200. Among the near-miss candidates alone it chose correctly 99% of the time. Laya put it first in 87% and in the top 3 in 96%, level with keyword search. Its multilingual checkpoint did worse (75.5% first).
rec_tools: use OpenJev when a GPU server is available: it put the right tool in the top 3 every time. Without a GPU, Laya or plain keyword search is a reasonable fast pre-filter for about 20 tools. Both put the right tool in the top 3 about 96% of the time, so send the LLM the top 3 to 5 tools, not just the first one.
